method: Live copy = Polydata-matched, joinable (40–12k closed, WR 48–75, median <$15k), HOT/WARM, unique-book ROI ≥5% (or last-30d turnaround ≥8% n≥30), ≥8 settled prints in 30d. Path-B: walk-forward Elite WR 75–85 + unique≥10%. Auto-bench after 90d no joinable prints. Scout = discovered candidates, refresh for vetting; auto_promote applies activity+equity gates (not vibes). Vigilant-Environment/sentrio/Mysaria excluded. Futures are not a copy lane (n=5, −37% after 2¢).
